name: cache-keepalive
description: Keep Claude Code's prompt cache warm across idle pauses. A Stop/UserPromptSubmit hook stamps activity; a background Monitor pings the session only once it has been idle long enough (default 50 min), which triggers a cache read and refreshes the prompt-cache TTL. Built for a 1h cache TTL; on request-quota subscriptions every ping eats quota, so disable it there.
